main_authored_provenance.selection: Main selected the existing Wainscott dining-room table as the fourth temporal layout.
main_authored_provenance.replaced_primary: Rejected Merom M2: initialization passed, but apparatus was outside the intended room and automatic relocation put one original carton into a cabinet; the narrow counter did not retain the intended open spaced row.
main_authored_provenance.preserved: Original source assets, scales, events, QA, thresholds, carton transforms and phase controls are retained. Only explicit apparatus world translation, vertical-only interaction placement and exact retained-furniture reset poses are added.
main_authored_provenance.geometry_evidence: Saved numeric inventory and main CPU room-map checks are proposals; no live native geometry, support, optical equivalence or physical validity is established.
main_authored_provenance.v2_correction: Main native V1 review found an unreset toppled chair contacting the moved chair and native table motion during the 90-step reset. V2 preserves every V1 task/layout choice and resets all six retained chairs to the explicitly selected XY positions with original saved Z and quaternion before restoring the original native table pose.
main_authored_provenance.qualification_scope: Initialization-only retained-furniture correction; authored bounds and fine room-map checks do not establish physics stability or task feasibility.
